title: Q1. The Magic Number Game
statement: A magician selects a secret magic number and asks the audience to enter numbers. Count how many inputs are divisible by the magic number. If none are divisible, print: Oops! No magic here. Otherwise print: Magic found: X numbers.

title: Q2. Alien Terraforming Mission
statement: An amplifier can increase the energy level of any city by 1 in one move. Find the minimum number of moves needed to make the given energy levels non-decreasing.

title: Q3. Bob and First Steps
statement: Given an array of daily earnings, find the maximum length of a contiguous subsegment whose values are in non-decreasing order.

title: Q4. Number of Ways
statement: Given a number, find how many ways it can be written as the sum of two or more consecutive natural numbers. The number itself is not counted.

title: Q5. Simple Gradient Descent
statement: A weight vector and a bias vector each have size 5. For T epochs, every element decreases by 2*alpha each epoch. Print the final five weights followed by the final five biases.

title: Q6. EEG Concentration Monitor
statement: Read 6 performance values. Output the average, best, worst, whether the average of the last three is below 40, and whether any three consecutive readings average above 90.

title: Q7. Deploy the Ackermans!
statement: Given a circular binary array representing safe (1) and breached (0) sectors, find the longest consecutive circular stretch of zeroes.

title: Q8. Shower Time
statement: Rohit needs s free minutes in a day of m minutes. Given non-overlapping busy intervals, print 1 if any free interval has length at least s, otherwise print 0.
